### **MOD INFORMATION**

* Author: Pico Senpai
* Mod Version: 1.0.1
* Modified Sounds: "Ability is not ready yet!" & "Not enough mana to cast that!" Sounds

### **DESCRIPTION**

* When using an ability that's on cooldown it no longer plays the annoying cooldown sound, same thing for when out of mana, no more sounds will play if you spam your abilities. Very useful on champions such as Ezreal, Zeri, or Cassiopeia
